# supabase/tests/fixtures/partner_kind_readers.txt
#
# verify-function-inventory check 14 (c): the functions OUTSIDE the *_for_partner family that are allowed to read the actor binding (the table private.actor_binding or the helpers
# partner_binding*) or the literal 'partner'. One `schema.name(identity args)` per line; '#' lines are comments. A NEW reader is added here only after review of what it does with the
# kind, or it belongs inside the *_for_partner family (whose first statement is private.partner_authorize). This is a TRIPWIRE, not a proof: a body that assembles the names at run time
# evades it (see the comment in tools/db/verify-function-inventory.mjs). supabase/tests/unit/function-inventory-check-parity.test.ts holds this file equal to the list embedded in
# 10_function_inventory.sql's twin of the check.
#
# The producers and readers of the binding itself:
private.actor_uid()
private.bind_actor_internal(p_uid uuid, p_kind text)
private.bind_partner_session(p_token_hash text)
private.partner_binding()
private.partner_binding_kind()
private.partner_binding_session()
private.partner_authorize(p_facility_id text, p_trail_id text, p_roles app.partner_role[], p_class text)
private.partner_audit_write(p_action text, p_subject_table text, p_subject_id text, p_detail jsonb)
private.partner_authority_revoke_sessions()
private.partner_pin_grant_consume()
# The user-lane definers that read the binding only to REFUSE a non-user kind (a system delegate, a partner) or to read the bound user; each is edge_actor / edge_system lane and
# is blind to a partner binding by construction (actor_uid() is NULL for it):
private.activate_entitlement_for_actor(p_entitlement_id uuid, p_device_id uuid, p_token_hash text, p_decision text, p_hold_detail jsonb)
private.activate_offer_code_for_actor(p_code_id uuid, p_device_id uuid, p_token_hash text, p_decision text, p_hold_detail jsonb)
private.claim_device_platform_for_actor(p_device_id uuid, p_platform text)
private.delete_my_data_for_actor()
private.export_my_data_for_actor()
private.offline_code_bound_staff()
private.offline_code_record_step_for_actor(p_device_id uuid, p_seed_version integer, p_step bigint, p_facility_id text)
private.offline_seed_for_actor(p_device_id uuid, p_rotate boolean)
private.register_attest_key_for_actor(p_device_id uuid, p_key_id text, p_public_key bytea)
private.signin_bound_user(p_who text)
private.signin_record_email_proof(p_caller_user_id uuid, p_target_user_id uuid, p_email text, p_provider text, p_provider_sub text, p_session_id uuid)
# S2a (0046): the player-lane marker-scan definers, same shape (they read the binding to take the bound user and REFUSE any kind but 'user', so a partner binding cannot scan):
private.course_pin_attempt_for_actor(p_facility_id text, p_pin text, p_at timestamp with time zone)
private.course_qr_public_key_for_actor(p_kid text, p_purpose text)
private.marker_cosignal_attach_for_actor(p_facility_id text, p_at timestamp with time zone, p_cosignal_grade text, p_cosignal_fix_id text, p_cosignal_evidence_id uuid)
private.marker_scan_for_actor(p_facility_id text, p_variant text, p_nonce_hash text, p_qr_kid text, p_pin text, p_at timestamp with time zone, p_cosignal_grade text, p_cosignal_fix_id text, p_cosignal_evidence_id uuid)
# 0048 (partner sign-in mint, S1.1b): the two MINT definers read the binding only to REFUSE any bound transaction (the 0041 rule: a minter binds nothing). Neither writes or reads a kind as authority.
private.partner_challenge_issue_sign_in()
private.partner_session_mint(p_token_hash text, p_credential_id bytea, p_nonce bytea, p_exp bigint, p_mac bytea, p_authenticator_data bytea, p_client_data_json bytea, p_signature bytea)
# 0049 (partner session edge core, S1.2): outside the *_for_partner family, five functions read the binding. hit_partner_rate_limit takes the bound PARTNER user for its bucket key and refuses any other kind
# (it authorises nothing: it counts). partner_credential_lookup and partner_sign_in_failure_record are minter-lane definers that read the binding only to REFUSE any bound transaction (the 0041 rule). partner_reauth_apply
# and partner_reauth_clear are owned by partner_reauth_verifier (R5-L1) and take the session from the binding: they are reachable only from partner_session_reauth_for_partner / partner_session_lock_for_partner,
# which begin with private.partner_authorize, and the role can write nothing but reauth_until of its own bound session.
private.hit_partner_rate_limit(p_bucket_key text, p_window interval, p_max integer)
private.partner_credential_lookup(p_credential_id bytea)
private.partner_sign_in_failure_record(p_credential_id bytea)
private.partner_reauth_apply(p_credential_id bytea, p_nonce bytea, p_exp bigint, p_mac bytea, p_authenticator_data bytea, p_client_data_json bytea, p_signature bytea)
private.partner_reauth_clear()
# 0052 (partner step-up PIN, S1.3): outside the *_for_partner family, five functions read the binding. partner_binding_user is the policy predicate of partner_pin_verifier (it returns the bound partner
# user and nothing else). partner_pin_verify_apply, partner_pin_set_apply and partner_pin_params_read are owned by partner_pin_verifier (R5-L1) and take the person and the session from the binding: they are reachable only from
# partner_pin_verify_for_partner / partner_pin_set_for_partner / partner_pin_change_for_partner / partner_pin_params_for_partner, which begin with private.partner_authorize, and the role can write nothing but
# pin_grant_until of its own bound session and the partner_pin row of its own bound person. partner_pin_grant_consume_fresh is the A2 twin of partner_pin_grant_consume (called by partner_authorize only).
private.partner_binding_user()
private.partner_pin_verify_apply(p_derived bytea)
private.partner_pin_set_apply(p_mode text, p_derived bytea, p_salt bytea, p_iterations integer, p_current bytea)
private.partner_pin_params_read()
private.partner_pin_grant_consume_fresh(p_max_age_seconds integer)
# 0053 (partner TOTP / aal 2, S1.4): outside the *_for_partner family, four functions owned by partner_totp_verifier (R5-L1) read the binding. enrol_apply / confirm_apply / verify_apply /
# mfa_clear take the person and the session from the binding and are reachable only from the A0_ENROL / A0_MFA / SESSION wrappers that begin with private.partner_authorize; the role can write
# nothing but aal / mfa_until of its own bound session and the partner_totp row of its own bound person (or, for admin reset, another admin/operator via reset_apply, which does not read the binding).
private.partner_totp_enrol_apply()
private.partner_totp_confirm_apply(p_code text)
private.partner_totp_verify_apply(p_code text)
private.partner_totp_mfa_clear()
# 0054 (partner invites / enrolment / members, S1.5): six functions outside the *_for_partner family read the binding kind, each ONLY to REFUSE any bound transaction (the 0041 rule: a minter binds
# nothing). The four accept / email definers and register_first are the minter lane's (owned by partner_session_issuer, EXECUTE for edge_partner_minter); partner_challenge_issue_register is the
# issuer-only producer of a register challenge. None reads a kind as authority, none writes the binding.
private.partner_challenge_issue_register(p_user_id uuid, p_ref_kind smallint, p_ref_id uuid, p_accepted_at_us bigint)
private.partner_invite_email_for_token(p_token_hash text)
private.partner_invite_accept(p_token_hash text, p_verified_uid uuid, p_gotrue_session_id uuid)
private.partner_enrolment_token_email_for_token(p_token_hash text)
private.partner_enrolment_token_accept(p_token_hash text, p_verified_uid uuid, p_gotrue_session_id uuid)
private.partner_credential_register_first(p_token_hash text, p_user_id uuid, p_ref_kind smallint, p_ref_id uuid, p_nonce bytea, p_exp bigint, p_mac bytea, p_attestation_object bytea, p_client_data_json bytea, p_credential_id bytea, p_public_key bytea, p_transports text[])
# 0056 (S3 attest and redeem): three policy predicates outside the *_for_partner family read the partner binding (they are keyed on it: the partner twins of 0045's offline_code_bound_staff). Each only answers a boolean to
# a private_definer policy; none writes the binding, none reads a kind as authority beyond 'this transaction is a partner binding of a staff / manager member'. EXECUTE for nobody but the owner.
private.partner_bound_staff_at(p_facility_id text)
private.partner_bound_manager_at(p_facility_id text)
private.partner_bound_staff_any()
# 0057 (S4 receipts and review): one policy predicate outside the *_for_partner family reads the partner binding (admin-only queue and resolve policies). EXECUTE for nobody but the owner.
private.partner_bound_admin()
